steps.expected: Both servers register so no-input/open-object tool-call behavior can be validated

steps.action: Inspect current MCP tool surface

assertions.title: OAuth refresh prefers protected-resource authorization server metadata

steps.action: Create OAuth Arcade MCP server and reinitialize
steps.expected: Server enters OAuth flow and can be driven to refresh-token branch
steps.observed: Server created and reinitialize returned oauthUrl with oauthRequired=true.

steps.action: Check OAuth flow status for refresh preconditions
steps.expected: Expired/refreshable token state available for refresh-endpoint validation
steps.observed: Flow state remained PENDING (no completed token), so refresh path was unreachable.

assertions.issues: Blocked: no authorized/expired OAuth token state available to exercise refresh behavior.

assertions.title: OAuth callback URLs preserve precedence rules across local and proxied deployments

steps.action: Reinitialize OAuth server directly
steps.expected: Callback URL generated from precedence chain
steps.observed: oauthUrl was returned with redirect_uri on localhost:3081 (consistent with DOMAIN_SERVER-local loopback behavior).

steps.action: Retry with forwarded host/proto and explicit oauth/initiate direct+forwarded probes
steps.expected: Forwarded-header precedence behavior observable
steps.observed: Forwarded reinitialize returned success:false without oauthUrl, and both oauth/initiate calls returned 400 Invalid flow state.

assertions.issues: Blocked: direct local loopback callback observed, but forwarded/request-host precedence branches were not conclusively observable from available flow state.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Create/reinitialize Arcade server in pending-consent state
steps.expected: Initialization succeeds with OAuth continuation metadata
steps.observed: Reinitialize returned success:true with oauthRequired=true and oauthUrl.

steps.action: Invoke MCP-backed scheduled run before consent
steps.expected: Tool invocation should surface auth continuation metadata (authorization_url/llm_instructions) instead of normal success
steps.observed: Scheduled invocation completed successfully and returned normal OneDrive-like JSON output while consent remained pending.

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent path produced successful tool output rather than auth-continuation response metadata.

assertions.title: Scheduled MCP and OAuth execution keeps the interactive auth contract

steps.action: Create OAuth-required Arcade MCP server and leave consent pending
steps.expected: Schedule execution should recheck pending MCP/OAuth auth state
steps.observed: Server reinitialize reported oauthRequired=true with oauthUrl (pending-consent state).

steps.action: Manual Run now on schedule targeting ephemeralAgent.mcp
steps.expected: Manual run fails durably with explicit auth failure; no success conversation
steps.observed: Manual run returned 200 succeeded with conversationId and OneDrive-like JSON preview.

steps.action: Background runner on enabled due schedule targeting same pending-consent MCP server
steps.expected: Background run also fails durably with explicit auth failure
steps.observed: Background run completed with lastStatus=succeeded, lastTriggeredBy=scheduler, and conversation linkage present.

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent OAuth MCP scheduled runs still succeed on both manual and background paths instead of durable auth failure.

assertions.title: Background runner picks up due schedules and advances next run correctly

steps.action: Create overdue enabled schedule and wait for runner poll
steps.expected: Auto execution occurs and nextRunAt advances
steps.observed: Runner picked up schedule (lastTriggeredBy=scheduler, runCount=1) and nextRunAt advanced; execution failed with res.clearCookie error but scheduling semantics advanced.

steps.action: Create disabled schedule and run manually
steps.expected: Disabled schedule does not auto-run; manual run executes once without advancing nextRunAt
steps.observed: Disabled schedule stayed idle until manual run; manual runCount incremented and nextRunAt remained unchanged.

steps.action: Validate SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED=false branch
steps.expected: Overdue enabled schedule remains untouched while manual Run now still works
steps.observed: Not executed in shared dev rail because toggling runner env mode is disruptive without an isolated runtime instance.

assertions.issues: Blocked on mandatory SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED=false branch due lack of non-disruptive isolated env toggle in this shared validation rail.

assertions.title: Notification delivery results are channel-specific and non-fatal

steps.action: Run successful scheduled execution with email/sms/push channels enabled
steps.expected: Execution succeeds and per-channel notification results are returned
steps.observed: Run succeeded (200) with conversationId and channel-level notificationResults (email/sms/push each skipped with explicit reasons).

steps.action: Run failing scheduled execution with same channels enabled
steps.expected: Execution fails durably while keeping per-channel notification results
steps.observed: Run failed (500 Illegal model request) and still returned channel-level notificationResults plus durable schedule failure metadata.

steps.action: Verify delivered payload URL root/click path when conversation exists
steps.expected: Delivered channel payload links use DOMAIN_CLIENT/c/<conversationId>; no-conversation path omits link
steps.observed: All channels were skipped (local delivery providers not configured), so delivered payload URL root could not be directly observed.

assertions.issues: Blocked on delivery-link verification because no deliverable email/SMS/push sink is configured in this dev environment.

assertions.title: Browser push subscription lifecycle persists and can be removed

steps.action: Subscribe, resubscribe same endpoint, add second endpoint, then unsubscribe first endpoint
steps.expected: Resubscribe refreshes without double-count and unsubscribe removes target endpoint
steps.observed: subscriptionCount stayed 1 on same-endpoint resubscribe, increased to 2 after second endpoint, then returned to 1 after unsubscribe.

steps.action: Run push-notification schedule with synthetic stale endpoint
steps.expected: 404/410 push failures prune expired endpoints
steps.observed: Push result reported failed 0/2 with expiredEndpoints=[] and subscriptionCount remained 2 (no prune triggered).

steps.action: Validate browser permission + delivered-notification click behavior
steps.expected: Delivered push opens/focuses linked conversation URL
steps.observed: Not validated in this API-only run; no browser delivery/click-path evidence collected.

assertions.issues: Blocked: API lifecycle semantics verified, but browser-native delivery/click behavior and 404/410 prune branch were not reproducible in this environment.
